revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor. A covered loading area with dock equipment, carts, wide concrete surface, dull stone flooring, neutral indoor illumination. Moderate side view at near-medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Main subject: a consenting adult actor with a curvy build wearing a burgundy coat and straight-leg trousers, black and teal clothing, lying horizontally across the corridor floor with full body visible from head to feet and supported by the ground. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, annotation, medical staff, ambulances, first-aid equipment, cones, instruction boards, or simulation signage.
